rationale: The symptom names 'observer look-angles' + 'wrong geodetic model' + 'WGS84' — observerEci builds the observer's ECI position with a spherical Earth (RE=6378.137, comment 'spherical Earth; ellipsoid/altitude refinement later') instead of the WGS84 ellipsoid, so every topocentric alt/az/range from lookAngle() is wrong. horizontal.ts is the look-alike: it owns the celestial ecliptic→equatorial→horizontal pipeline whose invariants the report cites, but its math is already correct (verified: vernal equinox→RA0/Dec0, ecliptic NP→Dec 90−ε, meridian-at-dec=lat→zenith), so patching it left the 2 failing tests failing.
